id-20260917-news-1.title: The Fed Officially Raises Interest Rates by 25 Bps to 3.75-4 Percent, Rupiah and IHSG Immediately Under Pressure

segments.src: ## Keputusan The Fed
segments.tr: ## The Fed's Decision

segments.src: Bank sentral Amerika Serikat, Federal Reserve (The Fed), resmi menaikkan suku bunga acuan sebesar 25 basis poin menjadi 3,75-4 persen dalam pertemuan Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) yang berlangsung pada 17 September 2026.
segments.tr: The United States central bank, the Federal Reserve (The Fed), officially raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.75-4 percent during the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting held on September 17, 2026.

segments.src: Keputusan ini sejalan dengan perkiraan sebagian besar pelaku pasar yang sebelumnya memperkirakan bank sentral masih akan melanjutkan sikap hati-hati terhadap tekanan inflasi yang belum sepenuhnya mereda.
segments.tr: This decision is in line with the expectations of most market participants who previously anticipated that the central bank would continue its cautious stance regarding inflationary pressures that have not fully subsided.

segments.src: Dalam pernyataan resminya, komite kebijakan moneter The Fed mengisyaratkan bahwa masih terbuka peluang satu kali kenaikan suku bunga lagi sebelum akhir tahun 2026, dengan tetap mempertimbangkan perkembangan data inflasi, pasar tenaga kerja, dan pertumbuhan ekonomi domestik Amerika Serikat dalam beberapa bulan mendatang.
segments.tr: In its official statement, The Fed's monetary policy committee signaled that there is still a possibility of one more rate hike before the end of 2026, while continuing to consider developments in inflation data, the labor market, and domestic economic growth in the United States in the coming months.

segments.src: Sikap ini menegaskan bahwa The Fed belum sepenuhnya yakin tren inflasi telah kembali ke jalur target jangka panjang sebesar 2 persen.
segments.tr: This stance confirms that The Fed is not yet fully convinced that the inflation trend has returned to its long-term target path of 2 percent.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke Rupiah
segments.tr: ## Impact on the Rupiah

segments.src: Sinyal kenaikan suku bunga lanjutan dari The Fed langsung direspons pasar valuta asing domestik.
segments.tr: The signal of further interest rate hikes from The Fed was immediately responded to by the domestic foreign exchange market.

segments.src: Nilai tukar rupiah melemah dan bergerak ke kisaran Rp17.650 per dolar AS pada perdagangan hari yang sama.
segments.tr: The rupiah exchange rate weakened and moved to the range of Rp17,650 per US dollar during the same day's trading.

segments.src: Pelemahan ini umumnya terjadi karena kenaikan suku bunga acuan AS membuat imbal hasil aset berdenominasi dolar menjadi lebih menarik, sehingga sebagian investor mengalihkan portofolionya ke instrumen dolar AS dan menekan mata uang negara berkembang, termasuk rupiah.
segments.tr: This weakening generally occurs because the rise in the US benchmark interest rate makes the yields on dollar-denominated assets more attractive, causing some investors to shift their portfolios to US dollar instruments and putting pressure on emerging market currencies, including the rupiah.

segments.src: Sejumlah analis pasar menilai pelemahan ini masih dalam batas yang wajar dan berpotensi bersifat sementara, tergantung pada langkah lanjutan otoritas moneter dalam negeri serta arah kebijakan The Fed berikutnya.
segments.tr: A number of market analysts assess that this weakening is still within reasonable limits and potentially temporary, depending on the subsequent steps taken by domestic monetary authorities and the direction of The Fed's next policies.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke IHSG
segments.tr: ## Impact on the IHSG

segments.src: Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) di Bursa Efek Indonesia turut mengalami tekanan dan ditutup melemah ke level 6.444.
segments.tr: The Composite Stock Price Index (IHSG) on the Indonesia Stock Exchange also experienced pressure and closed lower at the 6,444 level.

segments.src: Sentimen kenaikan suku bunga global umumnya mendorong investor bersikap lebih berhati-hati terhadap aset berisiko seperti saham, terutama pada sektor-sektor yang sensitif terhadap biaya pendanaan seperti properti, perbankan, dan konsumer.
segments.tr: Global interest rate hike sentiment generally encourages investors to be more cautious regarding risky assets such as stocks, especially in sectors sensitive to funding costs such as property, banking, and consumer goods.

segments.src: Beberapa analis pasar modal menyebut koreksi ini sebagai respons jangka pendek yang lazim terjadi setiap kali The Fed mengumumkan kebijakan suku bunga baru, dan menyarankan investor untuk mencermati perkembangan data ekonomi lanjutan sebelum mengambil keputusan investasi.
segments.tr: Some capital market analysts refer to this correction as a short-term response that commonly occurs whenever The Fed announces new interest rate policies, and they advise investors to closely monitor further economic data developments before making investment decisions.

segments.src: ## Respons dan Langkah Antisipasi
segments.tr: ## Response and Anticipatory Measures

segments.src: Otoritas moneter dan fiskal dalam negeri disebut akan terus memantau perkembangan pasar keuangan global untuk menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar dan pasar modal domestik.
segments.tr: Domestic monetary and fiscal authorities are said to be continuing to monitor global financial market developments to maintain the stability of the exchange rate and the domestic capital market.

segments.src: Langkah-langkah stabilisasi, termasuk intervensi pasar bila diperlukan, menjadi salah satu opsi yang biasa ditempuh otoritas terkait dalam menghadapi gejolak pasar akibat kebijakan bank sentral negara maju.
segments.tr: Stabilization measures, including market intervention if necessary, are one of the options commonly taken by relevant authorities in facing market volatility caused by the policies of developed countries' central banks.

segments.src: Para pelaku pasar kini menanti pernyataan lanjutan dari pejabat The Fed serta rilis data ekonomi AS berikutnya, yang akan menjadi acuan penting dalam menentukan arah kebijakan suku bunga pada sisa tahun 2026.
segments.tr: Market participants are now awaiting further statements from The Fed officials as well as the release of the next US economic data, which will serve as an important benchmark in determining the direction of interest rate policy for the remainder of 2026.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan rekomendasi atau nasihat keuangan.
segments.tr: *This article is prepared for general information purposes and does not constitute a recommendation or financial advice.

id-20260917-news-2.title: IDX Gradually Reopens Short Selling Transactions, Claimed to Boost Market Liquidity by up to 17 Percent

segments.src: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) berencana mengaktifkan kembali transaksi *short selling* atau transaksi jual saham dengan mekanisme pinjam-meminjam efek secara bertahap mulai pertengahan September 2026.
segments.tr: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) plans to reactivate *short selling* transactions—or the selling of shares through a securities lending and borrowing mechanism—gradually starting in mid-September 2026.

segments.src: Langkah ini menandai babak baru bagi pasar modal domestik setelah mekanisme tersebut sempat dibatasi dalam beberapa waktu terakhir sebagai bagian dari upaya menjaga stabilitas perdagangan.
segments.tr: This step marks a new chapter for the domestic capital market after the mechanism was temporarily restricted in recent times as part of efforts to maintain trading stability.

segments.src: ## Cakupan Awal Dibatasi pada Saham LQ45
segments.tr: ## Initial Scope Limited to LQ45 Stocks

segments.src: Menurut keterangan yang beredar dari otoritas bursa, tahap awal reaktivasi *short selling* akan difokuskan pada saham-saham yang tergabung dalam indeks LQ45.
segments.tr: According to statements circulating from exchange authorities, the initial phase of *short selling* reactivation will be focused on stocks included in the LQ45 index.

segments.src: Pemilihan ini didasarkan pada pertimbangan bahwa saham-saham dalam indeks tersebut umumnya memiliki likuiditas tinggi, kapitalisasi pasar besar, serta pengawasan transaksi yang lebih ketat, sehingga risiko volatilitas berlebih dapat diminimalkan pada masa transisi.
segments.tr: This selection is based on the consideration that stocks in this index generally have high liquidity, large market capitalization, and stricter transaction supervision, so the risk of excessive volatility can be minimized during the transition period.

segments.src: Pihak BEI menyebutkan bahwa daftar resmi efek yang dapat ditransaksikan melalui skema *short selling* akan diterbitkan pada 28 September 2026.
segments.tr: The IDX stated that the official list of securities that can be traded via the *short selling* scheme will be published on September 28, 2026.

segments.src: Setelah daftar tersebut dipublikasikan, mekanisme ini ditargetkan berlaku penuh mulai Oktober 2026, seiring dengan penyesuaian sistem perdagangan dan kesiapan anggota bursa selaku perantara transaksi.
segments.tr: Once the list is published, this mechanism is targeted to take full effect starting in October 2026, in line with trading system adjustments and the readiness of exchange members as transaction intermediaries.

segments.src: ## Klaim Peningkatan Likuiditas hingga 17 Persen
segments.tr: ## Claim of Liquidity Increase of up to 17 Percent

segments.src: Sejumlah analis pasar modal yang mencermati rencana ini memperkirakan pembukaan kembali *short selling* berpotensi mendorong peningkatan likuiditas transaksi harian di Bursa Efek Indonesia hingga kisaran 17 persen dibandingkan kondisi saat ini.
segments.tr: A number of capital market analysts observing this plan estimate that the reopening of *short selling* has the potential to encourage an increase in daily transaction liquidity on the Indonesia Stock Exchange by around 17 percent compared to current conditions.

segments.src: Proyeksi tersebut didasarkan pada asumsi bertambahnya variasi strategi investasi yang dapat digunakan pelaku pasar, termasuk investor institusi dan manajer investasi, dalam mengelola portofolio mereka di tengah fluktuasi harga saham.
segments.tr: This projection is based on the assumption of an increase in the variety of investment strategies that can be used by market participants, including institutional investors and investment managers, in managing their portfolios amid stock price fluctuations.

segments.src: Meski demikian, perlu digarisbawahi bahwa angka tersebut masih bersifat estimasi dan proyeksi awal.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, it needs to be underlined that this figure is still an estimation and initial projection.

segments.src: Realisasinya akan sangat bergantung pada berbagai faktor, seperti kondisi makroekonomi, sentimen pasar global, tingkat partisipasi investor, serta kesiapan infrastruktur pendukung dari perusahaan sekuritas dan lembaga kliring.
segments.tr: Its realization will heavily depend on various factors, such as macroeconomic conditions, global market sentiment, the level of investor participation, and the readiness of supporting infrastructure from securities companies and clearing institutions.

segments.src: ## Alasan di Balik Reaktivasi Bertahap
segments.tr: ## Reasons Behind the Gradual Reactivation

segments.src: Pendekatan bertahap yang diambil BEI dinilai sebagai langkah kehati-hatian mengingat *short selling* merupakan instrumen yang memiliki karakteristik risiko berbeda dari transaksi jual beli saham konvensional.
segments.tr: The gradual approach taken by the IDX is considered a cautious step given that *short selling* is an instrument that has different risk characteristics from conventional stock trading transactions.

segments.src: Dalam mekanisme ini, investor meminjam saham untuk dijual dengan harapan dapat membelinya kembali pada harga yang lebih rendah di kemudian hari.
segments.tr: In this mechanism, investors borrow shares to sell with the hope of buying them back at a lower price at a later date.

segments.src: Beberapa poin yang menjadi perhatian otoritas dalam proses reaktivasi ini antara lain:
segments.tr: Several points of concern for the authorities in this reactivation process include:

segments.src: - **Penguatan sistem pengawasan**, agar potensi penyalahgunaan mekanisme untuk tujuan spekulatif berlebihan dapat dideteksi lebih dini.
segments.tr: - **Strengthening the monitoring system**, so that the potential misuse of the mechanism for excessive speculative purposes can be detected earlier.

segments.src: - **Kesiapan anggota bursa**, termasuk perusahaan efek yang menyediakan fasilitas pinjam-meminjam saham.
segments.tr: - **Readiness of exchange members**, including securities companies providing the share lending and borrowing facility.

segments.src: - **Edukasi investor**, mengingat *short selling* memiliki profil risiko yang berbeda dan memerlukan pemahaman teknis yang lebih mendalam dibandingkan transaksi biasa.
segments.tr: - **Investor education**, considering that *short selling* has a different risk profile and requires a deeper technical understanding compared to regular transactions.

segments.src: - **Evaluasi berkala**, sehingga cakupan saham yang dapat ditransaksikan dapat diperluas secara terukur apabila tahap awal berjalan sesuai harapan.
segments.tr: - **Periodic evaluation**, so that the scope of stocks that can be traded can be expanded in a measurable way if the initial phase goes according to expectations.

segments.src: ## Respons Pelaku Pasar
segments.tr: ## Market Participant Response

segments.src: Rencana ini disambut beragam oleh pelaku pasar.
segments.tr: This plan has been met with mixed responses from market participants.

segments.src: Sebagian pihak menilai langkah ini dapat memperdalam pasar modal Indonesia dan membuatnya lebih setara dengan bursa-bursa di kawasan yang telah lama menerapkan mekanisme serupa.
segments.tr: Some parties assess that this step can deepen the Indonesian capital market and make it more on par with exchanges in the region that have long implemented similar mechanisms.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, sejumlah pihak juga mengingatkan pentingnya kesiapan mitigasi risiko, mengingat volatilitas pasar keuangan global masih menjadi tantangan tersendiri.
segments.tr: On the other hand, a number of parties also remind us of the importance of risk mitigation readiness, given that global financial market volatility remains a distinct challenge.

segments.src: Investor ritel maupun institusi disarankan untuk terus memantau pengumuman resmi dari BEI dan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) terkait daftar efek serta ketentuan teknis pelaksanaan *short selling* ini, mengingat aturan main dan daftar saham yang dapat ditransaksikan berpotensi mengalami penyesuaian hingga menjelang penerapan penuh pada Oktober 2026.
segments.tr: Retail and institutional investors are advised to continue monitoring official announcements from the IDX and the Financial Services Authority (OJK) regarding the list of securities and technical provisions for implementing this *short selling*, given that the rules of the game and the list of tradable stocks have the potential to undergo adjustments leading up to full implementation in October 2026.

segments.src: *Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan tidak dimaksudkan sebagai rekomendasi atau saran investasi.
segments.tr: *This article is informational in nature and is not intended as a recommendation or investment advice.

segments.src: Keputusan transaksi di pasar modal sepenuhnya menjadi tanggung jawab masing-masing investor, dan disarankan untuk melakukan riset mandiri atau berkonsultasi dengan penasihat keuangan berizin sebelum mengambil keputusan.*
segments.tr: Transaction decisions in the capital market are entirely the responsibility of each investor, and it is recommended to conduct independent research or consult with a licensed financial advisor before making a decision.*

id-20260917-news-3.title: KPK Uncovers ATR/BPN Land Mafia, 20th OTT Ensnared Director General, Summarecon Boss, and Golkar Politician

segments.src: ## Operasi Senyap Berujung Delapan Tersangka
segments.tr: ## Silent Operation Resulting in Eight Suspects

segments.src: Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) kembali menggelar operasi tangkap tangan (OTT) yang menyasar dugaan praktik mafia tanah di lingkungan Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang/Badan Pertanahan Nasional (ATR/BPN).
segments.tr: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) has once again conducted a sting operation (OTT) targeting alleged land mafia practices within the Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning/National Land Agency (ATR/BPN).

segments.src: Operasi ini disebut-sebut sebagai OTT ke-20 yang dilakukan lembaga antirasuah sejak beberapa tahun terakhir, dan menjadi salah satu operasi dengan cakupan pihak yang diduga terlibat paling luas dalam beberapa waktu terakhir.
segments.tr: This operation is hailed as the 20th OTT carried out by the anti-corruption agency in recent years, and stands as one of the operations with the widest scope of allegedly involved parties in recent times.

segments.src: Dari hasil operasi tersebut, KPK menetapkan delapan orang sebagai tersangka.
segments.tr: From the results of the operation, the KPK named eight individuals as suspects.

segments.src: Beberapa nama yang mencuat ke publik di antaranya seorang pejabat di Direktorat Jenderal Pengendalian dan Penertiban Tanah ATR/BPN, Presiden Direktur salah satu perusahaan properti besar yakni Summarecon Agung, serta politikus Partai Golkar, Fahd A Rafiq.
segments.tr: Several names that emerged to the public include an official at the Directorate General of Land Control and Order of ATR/BPN, the President Director of a major property company namely Summarecon Agung, as well as Golkar Party politician, Fahd A Rafiq.

segments.src: Penetapan status tersangka terhadap kedelapan pihak ini didasarkan pada alat bukti permulaan yang dikantongi penyidik, dan seluruh pihak yang disebut tetap memiliki hak praduga tak bersalah serta hak untuk membela diri melalui proses hukum yang berlaku.
segments.tr: The designation of suspect status for these eight parties is based on preliminary evidence pocketed by investigators, and all named parties still retain the presumption of innocence and the right to defend themselves through the applicable legal process.

segments.src: ## Barang Bukti Uang Tunai Rp106,3 Miliar
segments.tr: ## Rp106.3 Billion Cash Evidence

segments.src: Dalam keterangan resminya, KPK menyebutkan bahwa dari rangkaian penggeledahan dan penangkapan yang dilakukan, tim penyidik mengamankan barang bukti berupa uang tunai dengan total nilai fantastis, yakni mencapai Rp106,3 miliar.
segments.tr: In its official statement, the KPK mentioned that from the series of searches and arrests carried out, the investigative team secured evidence in the form of cash with a fantastic total value, reaching Rp106.3 billion.

segments.src: Uang tersebut ditemukan dalam berbagai pecahan mata uang dan disimpan di sejumlah lokasi berbeda, termasuk di kantor kementerian maupun kediaman pribadi pihak-pihak yang diperiksa.
segments.tr: The money was found in various currency denominations and stored in a number of different locations, including at the ministry office as well as the private residences of the parties being examined.

segments.src: Besarnya nilai uang yang diamankan membuat kasus ini menjadi sorotan publik, mengingat nominalnya jauh melampaui rata-rata barang bukti pada operasi-operasi serupa sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The massive value of the secured money makes this case a public spotlight, considering its nominal value far exceeds the average evidence in similar previous operations.

segments.src: KPK menyatakan masih akan terus menelusuri aliran dana tersebut untuk memastikan asal-usul serta kemungkinan keterlibatan pihak lain yang belum terungkap.
segments.tr: The KPK stated that it will continue to trace the flow of funds to ascertain the origin as well as the possibility of involvement of other parties not yet revealed.

segments.src: ## Dugaan Modus Mafia Tanah
segments.tr: ## Alleged Land Mafia Modus Operandi

segments.src: Berdasarkan penelusuran awal, dugaan praktik yang terjadi berkaitan dengan penerbitan maupun pengurusan sertifikat serta status lahan yang diduga dilakukan secara tidak sesuai prosedur demi memuluskan kepentingan bisnis properti tertentu.
segments.tr: Based on initial tracing, the alleged practices occurring relate to the issuance or processing of certificates and land status allegedly carried out non-procedurally to smooth certain property business interests.

segments.src: Praktik semacam ini sering disebut sebagai "mafia tanah", istilah yang merujuk pada jaringan yang memanfaatkan celah birokrasi pertanahan untuk keuntungan pribadi maupun kelompok, dengan modus mulai dari pemalsuan dokumen hingga suap kepada pejabat berwenang.
segments.tr: Practices of this sort are often referred to as a "land mafia", a term referring to networks that exploit land bureaucracy loopholes for personal or group gain, with moduses ranging from document falsification to bribery of authorized officials.

segments.src: Pimpinan KPK menegaskan bahwa pemberantasan mafia tanah menjadi salah satu prioritas lembaga, mengingat sektor pertanahan kerap dinilai rawan praktik korupsi karena melibatkan nilai aset yang sangat besar serta proses administrasi yang kompleks.
segments.tr: KPK leaders emphasized that eradicating the land mafia is one of the agency's priorities, considering the land sector is often deemed vulnerable to corruption practices because it involves very large asset values as well as complex administrative processes.

segments.src: ## Tanggapan Pihak-Pihak Terkait
segments.tr: ## Response from Related Parties

segments.src: Menyusul terungkapnya kasus ini, Kementerian ATR/BPN menyatakan akan sepenuhnya mendukung dan bekerja sama dengan proses hukum yang dijalankan KPK, sekaligus melakukan evaluasi internal terhadap sistem pelayanan pertanahan agar celah serupa tidak terulang di kemudian hari.
segments.tr: Following the revelation of this case, the ATR/BPN Ministry stated it will fully support and cooperate with the legal process run by the KPK, while simultaneously conducting an internal evaluation of the land service system so that similar loopholes do not recur in the future.

segments.src: Sementara itu, pihak manajemen Summarecon Agung menyampaikan bahwa perusahaan menghormati proses hukum yang sedang berjalan dan akan kooperatif jika diperlukan keterangan lebih lanjut oleh penyidik.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, the management of Summarecon Agung conveyed that the company respects the ongoing legal process and will be cooperative if further information is required by investigators.

segments.src: Partai Golkar pun disebut tengah menunggu perkembangan resmi dari KPK terkait status kadernya sebelum mengambil sikap organisasi lebih lanjut.
segments.tr: The Golkar Party is also said to be awaiting official developments from the KPK regarding its cadre's status before taking further organizational stance.

segments.src: ## Proses Hukum Berlanjut
segments.tr: ## Legal Process Continues

segments.src: Sesuai prosedur, para pihak yang diamankan dalam OTT akan menjalani pemeriksaan intensif selama masa penahanan awal sebelum KPK mengumumkan secara resmi konstruksi perkara serta pasal yang disangkakan kepada masing-masing tersangka dalam konferensi pers lanjutan.
segments.tr: As per procedure, the parties secured in the OTT will undergo intensive examination during the initial detention period before the KPK officially announces the case construction and the articles alleged against each suspect in a follow-up press conference.

segments.src: KPK juga membuka kemungkinan pengembangan kasus apabila ditemukan indikasi keterlibatan pihak-pihak tambahan seiring berjalannya penyidikan.
segments.tr: The KPK also opens up the possibility of case development if indications of additional parties' involvement are found along with the progression of the investigation.

segments.src: Kasus ini kembali menegaskan urgensi reformasi tata kelola pertanahan di Indonesia, sekaligus menjadi pengingat bahwa pengawasan ketat dan transparansi dalam pelayanan publik masih menjadi pekerjaan rumah besar bagi pemberantasan korupsi di sektor agraria.
segments.tr: This case reaffirms the urgency of land governance reform in Indonesia, and serves as a reminder that strict supervision and transparency in public service remain a major homework assignment for the eradication of corruption in the agrarian sector.
